guidance.CODE_NOW: Implement the closure on the default path, with a mutation-verified test and an in-lane skeptic.
guidance.DECIDE_ADR: Decide it under the 2026-10-24 delegation with a new ADR in your block, then implement it.
guidance.DEFAULT_WIRING: Wire the paper-only default in the composition root, failing closed. A protected path gets a patch under docs/blueprint/lanes/.
guidance.OWNER_COST: If closing it needs new billed infrastructure (Spanner, Bigtable, Dataplex, a BigQuery reservation, GPU/TPU, a new pool), leave it PARTIAL and name the cost in the gap: the owner decides. If it is only an accepted ADR declining the clause, with no cost, decide it with a new ADR (supersede it or record the decline) and grade it honestly. ADR 0150 quantum gates stay, under the classical-baseline principle.
guidance.OWNER_RISKLIMIT: Leave PARTIAL. It defines new capital or risk budgets, which the owner reserved.
guidance.OWNER_LIVE: Leave PARTIAL or BLOCKED. It is not decidable under the delegation.
guidance.DEPENDS: Close it once the rows it names are closed; check those first.
guidance.DEPLOY: Leave PARTIAL. It needs a running deployment.
guidance.EXTERNAL: Leave PARTIAL. It needs a credential, vendor or licence.
